executiveSummary.headline: Maximum length executive headline for wrap testing xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
executiveSummary.summary: This executive summary is at the nine hundred character schema maximum. It exists so the summary block is laid out against the longest text the model may produce, including the prose measure, the line height and the spacing beneath it. A real summary written for a business owner would run three to five sentences and land well under this limit, but the component must remain readable at the boundary rather than only at the average case, because the average case is not what breaks layouts. Long paragraphs are exactly where a measure that is too wide becomes obvious, where insufficient line height becomes tiring, and where a container without a maximum width starts producing lines the eye cannot track back from. Testing at the cap is the only way to be certain none of those happen in production. xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
